_note: 學習路徑內容建置第11批 #6／6：複合關係代名詞 what（eng.t_adv.relcl.what，學測級／高階）。what＝the thing(s) that，本身已含先行詞，引導名詞子句，可當主詞（What he did surprised everyone）或受詞（I believe what you said）。防第二正解＝用『有無先行詞』鎖 what vs that/which：無先行詞用 what（that/which 錯）、有先行詞用 that/which（what 錯、且不說 the thing what）。that/which 不同時並列以免第二正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rwh_）。

units.title_zh: 複合關係代名詞 what（＝the thing that）
units.can_do: 我能用 what（＝the thing(s) that，本身含先行詞）引導名詞子句，當句子的主詞或受詞，並知道只有在『沒有先行詞』時才用 what；有名詞先行詞時改用 that／which，且不說 the thing what。
units.situation_group: 關係子句 The relative what
units.subject: eng

claims.text: As a relative pronoun, 'what' means 'the thing(s) that' and includes its own antecedent, so there is no separate noun before it: 'I believe what you said' (= the thing that you said).
claims.verification_ref: what＝the thing(s) that，自帶先行詞、前面無名詞；I believe what you said；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'what'-clause works as a noun: it can be the subject ('What he did surprised everyone') or the object ('I understand what you mean') of a sentence.
claims.verification_ref: what 子句當名詞子句，可當主詞或受詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'what' only when there is NO antecedent (no noun before it); when there IS an antecedent, use 'that' or 'which' instead: 'the book that I read' (antecedent 'book') vs 'what I read' (no antecedent).
claims.verification_ref: 無先行詞用 what、有先行詞用 that/which；the book that I read vs what I read；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Because 'what' already contains 'the thing(s) that', we do not add another noun before it: we do not say 'the thing what I saved' — we say 'the thing that I saved' or just 'what I saved'.
claims.verification_ref: what 已含 the thing that，不再加名詞；不說 the thing what；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'what' as a relative pronoun means 'the thing(s) that'. It already includes the noun, so no noun comes before it: I believe what you said. (= the thing that you said.)
teach.zh_hint: 關係代名詞 what 的意思是『the thing(s) that（……的那個東西／那些事）』，本身已把先行詞包進去，所以前面不會再有一個名詞：I believe what you said.（我相信你說的話。）

teach.body: I don't understand what you mean.
teach.zh_hint: 我不懂你的意思。what＝你所指的那件事。

teach.body: A 'what'-clause works like a noun. It can be the subject or the object of a sentence: What he did surprised everyone. (subject) / She gave me what I needed. (object)
teach.zh_hint: what 引導的子句像一個名詞，可以當句子的主詞或受詞：What he did surprised everyone.（他做的事讓大家吃驚＝主詞）／She gave me what I needed.（她給我所需要的＝受詞）

teach.body: What matters most is your health.
teach.zh_hint: 最重要的是你的健康。what 子句當整句主詞。

teach.body: Use 'what' only when there is NO noun before it. If there is a noun, use 'that' or 'which' instead: the gift that you gave (noun 'gift' → 'that') vs. what you gave (no noun → 'what'). And we do not say 'the thing what you gave' — 'what' already means 'the thing that'.
teach.zh_hint: 只有『前面沒有名詞（沒有先行詞）』時才用 what；前面有名詞就改用 that／which：the gift that you gave（有名詞 gift→用 that）對比 what you gave（沒名詞→用 what）。也不說 the thing what you gave（what 已含 the thing that）。

teach.body: Tell me what you want for dinner.
teach.zh_hint: 告訴我你晚餐想吃什麼。前面沒有名詞→用 what。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞（前面沒有名詞）：I didn't hear ____ you just said.（我沒聽到你剛剛說的話）

distractor_rationales.that: 前面沒有名詞先行詞，that 不能這樣引導受詞子句；用 what（＝the thing that）。
distractor_rationales.which: which 需要先行詞（前面要有名詞）；這裡沒有，用 what。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人；這裡指『說的話（事物）』，用 what。

practice.feedback: 前面沒有名詞、指『……的話』用 what：what you just said。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞（前面有名詞 the book）：Please return the book ____ I lent you.（請把我借你的那本書還我）

distractor_rationales.what: 前面已有名詞 the book（先行詞），不用 what；用 that。不說 the book what。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人；book 是物，用 that。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表所有格『誰的』，意思不合。

practice.feedback: 前面有名詞先行詞（book）用 that：the book that I lent you。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞（子句當整句主詞、前面沒有名詞）：____ he said made everyone laugh.（他說的話讓大家笑了）

distractor_rationales.That: 這裡要一個當主詞的名詞子句、且前面沒有名詞；That he said 不完整，用 What。
distractor_rationales.Which: Which 需要先行詞，這裡沒有名詞先行詞。
distractor_rationales.It: It 是代名詞，後面不能直接接 he said 當關係子句。

practice.feedback: 沒有先行詞、子句當主詞用 What：What he said made everyone laugh。

options: This is the thing what I wanted.
This is what thing I wanted.

what 已含 the thing that，不再加 the thing；說 what I wanted 或 the thing that I wanted。
what 後面不再接名詞 thing；直接 what I wanted。
which 需要先行詞（前面要有名詞）；這裡沒有，用 what。

practice.feedback: what＝the thing that，直接說 what I wanted（不加 the thing）。

options: the place where you need it

distractor_rationales.the reason you need it: that would be 'why'; 'what' means the thing/things.
distractor_rationales.the place where you need it: that would be 'where'; 'what' means the thing/things.
distractor_rationales.the way you need it: that would be 'how'; 'what' means the thing/things.

practice.feedback: what you need = the thing(s) that you need.

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: What he told me is not what I expected.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：當主詞的 What he told me 和當補語的 what I expected 兩個 what 有沒有寫對、is not 有沒有寫對，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。what 子句連貫一起唸，句尾下收。

lines.text: I believe what you told me.
lines.intonation: I believe 輕起、what you told me 連貫、句尾下收

lines.text: What matters most is being kind.
lines.intonation: What matters most 當主詞連貫、is being kind 句尾下收
